origin.origins_backgrounds.acolyte.name: Kaihautū
origin.origins_backgrounds.acolyte.descr: Kua oti te whakangungu i ngā Akōrite i ngā Kaitiaki, ā, he nui tō rātou whakapono.
origin.origins_backgrounds.athlete.name: He kaitākaro hākinakina
origin.origins_backgrounds.athlete.descr: Kua oti i ngā kaitākaro te whakangungu i ō rātou tinana kia tino pai.
origin.origins_backgrounds.farmhand.name: Te kaimahi ā-whenua
origin.origins_backgrounds.farmhand.desc: I whakapaua e rātau te wā e mahi ana i te pāmu a tētahi atu.
origin.origins_backgrounds.fisher.name: Ngā Kaihoko Ika
origin.origins_backgrounds.fisher.descri: Kua ako nga kaihao ika i te toi o te hī ika.
origin.origins_backgrounds.guard.name: Kaitiaki
origin.origins_backgrounds.guard.descrip: Na te tiaki i ētahi atu me o rātau taonga utu nui i ako ai rātau ki te tiaki i a rātau anō.
origin.origins_backgrounds.haunted.name: He mea whakamataku
origin.origins_backgrounds.haunted.descr: Ehara i te mea he tangata kē ki te pōuri me te aitua, e mau puku ana ngā Haunted i ō rātou mamae.
origin.origins_backgrounds.retainer.name: Kaitiaki
origin.origins_backgrounds.retainer.desc: E haere tonu ana te tikanga o te whānau o te mahi ki tētahi Ariki, ki tētahi Toa rānei.
origin.origins_backgrounds.novice_mage.d: I tīmata ngā tauhou ki te whakangungu i raro i te ārahi a te Wizard.
origin.origins_backgrounds.sailor.name: He kaipuke
origin.origins_backgrounds.sailor.descri: He nui rawa te wā e whakapaua ana e ngā kaipuke ki te tātari i te papa.
origin.origins_backgrounds.pirate.name: He kaitiaki
origin.origins_backgrounds.pirate.descri: Ko to rātau aroha anake ko te moana, me ngā emerala. He maha ngā emerala.
origin.origins_backgrounds.cultist.name: He kaiwhaiwhai
origin.origins_backgrounds.cultist.descr: E mahi ana ngā kaiwhaiwhai i ō rātou atua i runga i ngā huarahi ngaro.
origin.origins_backgrounds.scribe.name: Kaituhi
origin.origins_backgrounds.scribe.descri: I te mutunga ka pahemo atu ngā ngoikoretanga o te ringa.
origin.origins_backgrounds.soldier.name: He hoia
origin.origins_backgrounds.soldier.descr: Ko te rangatiratanga o te ope a te Ariki.
origin.origins_backgrounds.fresh_face.de: Kāore anō kia mahia e rātau tētahi mea nui.
origin.origins_backgrounds.coalminer.des: Me keri ngā kōhao katoa o raro i te whenua, ehara i te waro anake.
origin.origins_backgrounds.cryptkeeper.d: He mahi uaua te tiaki i ngā urupa o te hunga mate ina kore e noho tonu.
power.origins_backgrounds.improved_heali: He Whakapai ake i te Whakaora
Ko te whakaora he 10% te kaha ake o te pānga ki a koe.
power.origins_backgrounds.faster_speed.d: Kua piki ake tō nekehanga whenua ki te 10%.
Ko ngā Porkchops o te Moana
Ka whiwhi koe i te nui ake o te kai mā te kai ika tunu.
power.origins_backgrounds.shield_prowess: Te kaha o te whakangungu rakau
I a koe e whakamahi ana i te whakangungu, ka riro i a koe te Whakaaetanga I.
power.origins_backgrounds.hello_darkness: He ārai koe ki te pānga pōuri.
power.origins_backgrounds.trusty_hoe.des: E whai koe i te Iron Hook enchanted i tukua i roto i nga whakatupuranga.
power.origins_backgrounds.attack_in_ocea: I te moana, ka rua te tere o ō whakaeke.
power.origins_backgrounds.eyepatch.name: Te whakapiri kanohi
power.origins_backgrounds.eyepatch.descr: Mā te whakakakahu kanohi i runga i te moana tuwhera e āhei ai koe ki te pupuri i tō Tirohanga Po.
power.origins_backgrounds.graves.name: Hoki atu ki ō koutou Ruuma
power.origins_backgrounds.graves.descrip: Mā tō mōhiotanga ki te hunga mate e āhei ai koe ki te whakapā atu i te 7.5% te kino ki te Undead.
power.origins_backgrounds.legacy_sword.d: E mau ana koe i te hoari o tō whānau.
power.origins_backgrounds.ore_harvesting: Ka tere ake te 5% o ōu maina.
power.origins_backgrounds.paperbacks.des: I muri i te tuhi i ngā pukapuka maha, e toru noa iho ngā pepa e hiahiatia ana hei here i tētahi.
power.origins_backgrounds.sacrifice.name: He manu whakahere
power.origins_backgrounds.sacrifice.desc: Ko te whakahere i ngā heihei ki tō ariki, ka rua ngā wheako.
Mā tō mahi ki te hoari e āhei ai koe ki te mahi i te 5% atu kino i a koe e mau ana i te hoari.
power.origins_backgrounds.potion_food.de: Kua inu koe i te maha o nga rongoā kua whai kai, kua ora.
